greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar's clear until pickup, so it's a good window to close out the trip's last loose ends before the car fills with kids.

needsAttention.detail: You need the full-size SUV for today's drive to Orlando and the rest of the trip; the p1 booking task is still open and overdue since Sept 9. Confirm it's actually reserved before pickup.

needsAttention.title: Buy the Disney tickets
needsAttention.detail: The only open item left for the Sept 26-27 Disney weekend: 6 park tickets. Check whether a Magic Kingdom Halloween-party night that weekend changes which park you pick.

needsAttention.title: Grocery stop on the Orlando drive
needsAttention.detail: The villa has a kitchen worth using for six people. Slot a shop near St. Pete before leaving or near Orlando on arrival so it doesn't get lost in the shuffle.

needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early and there's no six-seater in Maine then. Book it refundable now; flagged 'this week,' overdue since Sept 14.
